title: 2026 regular season, weeks 1-10, page-verified against the official week schedule pages

source.method: Transcribed line by line from the official week schedule page for each week. A game enters the corpus only if the page prints it as FINAL with both scores; a game the page prints as live or unplayed is excluded and carries no score. Every row keeps the game-centre URL printed on the page.

excluded_not_final.printed_as: 0-0, Q1, NBC — Live at read time
Chargers at Ravens, Monday, November 16th, 8:15 PM, ESPN

independence_check.check: Every club's W-L-T, PF and PA derived from this corpus is compared with the official league standings page, which was transcribed before the derived records were computed.

reconciliation_vs_inherited_feed.inherited_note: Base archive: nfl-command/data/games_2026_verified.json (each row carries an official nfl.com game URL). This session re-read 32 games line by line from official score/game pages (Weeks 1 and 9 in full, Week 10 Thursday) and recomputed all 32 teams' W-L-T/PF/PA against the official standings page read line by line on 2026-11-14 (V-01..V-03). Rows marked aggregate_only were not re-read page-by-page this session and are flagged, not certified.
reconciliation_vs_inherited_feed.rule: Neither file is silently preferred. A disagreement is published with both values and the official page URL so it can be re-read by hand.
